title: Painting a Backlit Parked Car in Casein
content: I painted this casein study while Jeanette was in the market, so I had about 45 minutes.I took a gamble on the car staying parked, and lost the gamble twice, but kept going anyway.(Link to video)Over an underpainting color ofCadmium Orangecasein, I usedCobalt Blue,Venetian Red,Ivory Black, andTitanium Whiteand focused on a simple warm/cool
